messages:
Maya: hey folks — PTAL on https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/9823 when you have a min. i addressed the feedback from last week: split the test helper into a fixture, reduced the KV cache churn, and rebased on main. i left a short note in the PR about the perf delta (+~0.6% p95) and why it's acceptable. need one approval to schedule a Friday canary.
Alex: looks small from a code perspective, will skim now. did you keep the previous behavior for cold starts?
Maya: yep — behavior unchanged for cold starts; only refactor + a small guard for nil pointers. test coverage added in kv_cache_test.go.
Priya: quick q — are we squashing or merging the commits? there are a couple of micro-fixes that might be useful to keep separate for future bisects.
Maya: i'm leaning merge (no squash) so we preserve the tiny fixes. i can squash if the release team prefers a single commit.
Ken: CI is green on the latest push but e2e flakes on alpha were noisy earlier this week. any rollback plan if canary shows regressions?
Maya: rollback plan: 1) pause traffic via route flag, 2) fallback to model-variant v2-compatible, 3) force-deploy previous image tag. i added the runbook link in the PR description.
Alex: reading the diff now. small nit: in runtime/kv/allocator.go the lock comment is slightly outdated. i'll add a trivial comment PR if you'd like me to.
Maya: please do — that would be great, thanks.
CI-bot: All checks passed for commit 3f4a9d7 (build, unit, lint).
Priya: +1 from me for merge (no squash). i ran the local perf harness and couldn't reproduce the p95 bump, looks safe.
Ken: i'm +1 but would prefer a short rollout window (15m) for the canary and an alert if tail latency > 20% over baseline. can we do that?
Maya: yes — canary window 15m, auto-rollback threshold configured in the canary job. i've updated the rollout config in infra/canary.yaml. snippet: ```canary: window: 15m rollback_on: tail_latency_pct_increase: 20```
Alex: left one tiny comment in the PR about a var name; otherwise LGTM.
Maya: addressed that var rename and pushed. thanks all. PTAL for final thumbs.
ReleaseBot: Available canary slots: Fri 10:00-10:30, Fri 14:00-14:30. Please confirm desired slot within 24h.
Priya: i'd pick 10:00 slot.
Ken: 10:00 works for me too.
Alex: 10:00 from me as well.
Maya: great — scheduling for Fri 10:00. i've marked the PR description with the slot and added a note to the release calendar. last call for objections. :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup: from me.
Maya: thanks everyone, i'll merge after a final CI pass and tag for canary. will follow up here if anything blocks.
CI-bot: Re-run triggered by Maya. All checks queued.
CI-bot: All checks passed for commit 5b7c21a (build, unit, e2e flake guard).
Maya: merged and pushed. PR #9823 merged to main (merge commit). sched job will pick it up for Fri 10:00 canary.
ReleaseBot: Canary scheduled: 4109940000 -> 4109940900 (Fri 10:00 slot). Notifications sent to #deployments and on-call.
Ken: thanks — will monitor dashboards during the window.
Priya: nice work, Maya.
Maya: thanks team! feel free to DM me if you catch anything during canary.
